cohort: 205 neonates admitted to the surgical NICU with a diagnosis of neonatal intestinal obstruction and managed surgically between September 1, 2015 and September 1, 2017.
finding: The overall survival rate for neonatal intestinal obstruction was 78%, with Hirschsprung's disease and anorectal malformation having the highest survival rates (around 90%) and intestinal atresia being the major cause of mortality.
